calls.title: Brent/Chris/Ashley
calls.summary: The team discussed significant challenges with data quality and lead source accuracy, impacting lead scoring models. Ashley pointed out that much lead source data is incomplete, complicating accurate attribution. A tiered scoring system was proposed to prioritize demo requests and active accounts, while concerns about data enrichment complexity emerged due to the use of multiple platforms. The team established that sales reps typically ramp up to one-third of their quota quarterly, comparing progress across new representatives. Key verticals for growth were identified, with an emphasis on fintech and strong potential in Germany. The meeting concluded with a staged approach to implementing lead scoring, focusing on the integration of fit and engagement scores as data quality improves.
calls.keywords: Lead scoring, Firmographics, Website engagement, Quota ramp, Sales productivity, Geographic markets
calls.action_items:

**Brent Holloway**

Continue iterative development of the lead scoring framework to integrate with HubSpot scoring modules, focusing on account and contact level scoring (27:34)

**Chris Newton**
Review lead scoring approach focusing on account-level prioritization and contact-level engagement integration, and provide feedback on implementation feasibility (17:30)
